title: bomify plugin PackResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success for its "pack" subcommand, per plugins/contracts/component/v1/CONTRACT.md: the component as an OCI artifact in its kind's own registry format, or {} for none. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

manifest.description: The artifact's manifest, or an index of several. Absent, with blobs, for a kind with no format of its own.

blobs.description: Every other blob the manifest refers to, directly or through the manifests an index names, in any order.

digest.description: The blob's OCI digest: sha256:<lowercase hex>.

path.description: A file within --input holding exactly the blob's bytes. bomify pull restores --input from the blobs whose file is there.

data.description: The bytes of a blob the plugin builds, such as a config or a manifest, base64: at most 4 MiB before encoding.
